description: This file is a security configuration class for a Spring Boot application, configuring security filters, password encoding, and request authorization rules.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security in the application, defining password encoding, security filter chain, and request security rules.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Bean providing an instance of BCryptPasswordEncoder for password hashing.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures and returns the SecurityFilterChain with security policies, including CSRF, CORS, session management, request authorization, and custom authentication filtering.
